feature_encoding: (position index, substituted residue index) for a single substitution
endpoint: viral replication; growth fitness, not binding affinity
direction: higher DMS_score is better within this assay only
top_fraction_note: A 512-candidate pool holds about five members at the 1% threshold used for GB1, too few for a stable recall estimate. Pathogen pools use 5%. These figures must never be compared with the GB1 1% figures.
limitations: The measured endpoint is viral replication; growth fitness, not binding affinity. It is not a macrocycle binding measurement and not an antiviral activity measurement.
Canonical single substitutions only: no non-canonical residue, no cyclisation and no macrocycle appears in this landscape.
Pools are sub-landscapes of one protein. Pool spread is descriptive variability, not biological replication across independent targets.
Metrics must not be pooled across landscapes with different assay endpoints.
